title: The Moon Pulling the Sea
short_teaser: Tides emerge from the gravitational relationships among Earth, the Moon, and the Sun, shaped further by coastlines and ocean depth.
story: Tides emerge from the gravitational relationships among Earth, the Moon, and the Sun, shaped further by coastlines and ocean depth. A distant object helps move enormous bodies of water. Influence does not require physical closeness to be powerful. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective. It reminds us that the world still contains more than we have noticed. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Influence does not require physical closeness to be powerful. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective. It reminds us that the world still contains more than we have noticed.
